examples.title: Linear progress
examples.description: The main pattern is a labelled linear bar. Values represent measured completion and are clamped to 0–100.

examples.title: Advance a local task
examples.description: The parent owns the value. Advance, finish and reset the local import while the fill and label settle together.

examples.title: Label positions
examples.description: right, bottom and none change the visible percentage. Keep an accessible name even when the visible label is hidden.

examples.title: Unknown completion
examples.description: indeterminate omits aria-valuenow and the percentage label. Use it while the amount of remaining work is unknown.

examples.title: Existing circular shapes
examples.description: The v2-only circle and semi-circle APIs remain available for existing installs. New documentation leads with the linear bar.
